notes.dem: Copernicus GLO-30 is a surface model (includes trees/buildings); use bare_frac to judge.
notes.horizon: near GLO-30 15 km buffer + GLO-90 far field at 180 m to 150 km, R_eff = 7/6 * 6371 km
notes.shadow_fixed_el: shadow_frac_el{1,3,5}: fraction of (pixel, 72 azimuths) below the horizon, same as Moon
notes.shadow_timeweighted: Earth: apparent sun el in (0,7] deg over 2026; below 1 deg refraction-uncertain
notes.image_tile_url: replace {date} with YYYY-MM-DD; GIBS HLS S30 goes to zoom 12 (~30 m)
notes.stage1: stage1_rank = best rank across the 27 region x hazard stage-1 searches (90 m, local shadow proxy)
